scripts.title: Onetap Hitbox Expander
scripts.features: Expands player and bot hitboxes to 100 studs and then changes them to ensure you are never inside them
scripts.script:
local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

while task.wait() do
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == game.Players.LocalPlayer then continue end
        if not player.Character then continue end

        
        local hitbox = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
        if not hitbox then continue end

        local head = hitbox:FindFirstChild("Hitbox_Head")
        if not head then continue end

        local size = 100

        if hrp then
            local dist = (head.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            size = math.clamp((dist - 5) * 2, 1, size)
        end

        local newSize = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
        if head.Size ~= newSize then
            head.Size = newSize
        end
    end

    for _, bot in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if bot:IsA("Model") and bot.Name ~= "Map" then      
            local hitbox = bot:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
            if not hitbox then continue end

            local head = hitbox:FindFirstChild("Hitbox_Head")
            if not head then continue end

            local size = 100

            if hrp then
                local dist = (head.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                size = math.clamp((dist - 2) * 2, 1, size)
            end

            local newSize = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
            if head.Size ~= newSize then
                head.Size = newSize
            end
        end
    end
end

local getgenv = getgenv or get_genv or function() return _G end
if not decompile then warn("Error: Your Executor Doesn't Support function decompile") return end

if not getgenv().Wevorn_Old_Decompile then
   getgenv().Wevorn_Old_Decompile = getgenv().decompile
end

local sus1, data1, sus2, data2, sus3, data3, sus4, data4= nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil 
getgenv().decompile = function(script)
   if not script then 
      warn("Error: Invalid Argument #1 In Function decompile")
      return

   if script:IsA("CoreScript") then
      local Name = script.Name
      if string.find(Name, "CoreScripts/") then
         Name = Name:gsub("^CoreScripts/", "")
      end
      if script.Name == "StarterScript" then
         return "\n-- Credits: Roblox Client Tracker\n"..game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaximumADHD/Roblox-Client-Tracker/refs/heads/roblox/scripts/CoreScripts/StarterScript.lua")

         return "\n-- Credits: Roblox Client Tracker\n"..game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaximumADHD/Roblox-Client-Tracker/refs/heads/roblox/scripts/CoreScripts/CoreScripts/"..Name.. ".lua")
      end)
      if not sus1 then

         end)
      else
         return data2

      if not sus3 then

            return "\n-- Credits: Roblox Client Tracker\n"..game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaximumADHD/Roblox-Client-Tracker/refs/heads/roblox/scripts/CoreScripts/"..Name.. ".lua")
         end)
      else
         return data3
      end
      if not sus4 then
         return "\nFailed To Decompile CoreScript\n"
      end
   else
      return getgenv().Wevorn_Old_Decompile(script)
   end
end

scripts.title: Universal RTX and SSR Shaders
scripts.features: An optimized and stable environmental reflection & lighting shader designed for Roblox. Bypasses the 31 highlight rendering limit by using a localized 55-stud proximity wrap and features automatic ground tracking. Highly stable, with zero player character cloning to ensure no hitbox or limb glitches. Includes 4 beautifully calibrated sky presets (Sunset, Day, Space, Cyberpunk) with forced-frame lighting updates to prevent day/night cycle overrides.
